tool_description: Recall memory through one shared tool. It supports newest-slot Clipboard recall, exact Recall Key or Record ID fetches, semantic Episodic search, and deterministic numbered Collection retrieval.

Recall Keys M1 through M100 always select Clipboard Memory. GHOST returns only the newest non-expired visible user/assistant pair stored in that exact slot; Clipboard recall has no semantic search, description-only mode, listing, or multi-call selection stage.
For ordinary exact recall, supply exactly one Recall Key or Record ID. GHOST directly returns that owner-scoped episode without vector search. Exact Collection episodes use this same path.

For semantic Episodic recall, formulate query_description and optional ISO date bounds. GHOST returns up to ten descriptions with workflow_state selection_required; select the best Record ID and call the same tool again for the final exact episode.

For numbered Collection recall, set memory_type to collection, target exactly one Collection ID or exact Collection Name, and select one mode: episode_number, episode_numbers, range, first, last, or all. GHOST returns a deterministic token-safe result and explicitly reports unavailable and omitted episode numbers.
The default result_mode is episode. Use description only when the user explicitly asks for descriptions of Episodic or Collection Memory. A workflow_state of complete is final.
server_instruction: When the user asks to recall M1 through M100, call ghost_memory_recall once with memory_type clipboard, that exact recall_key, and result_mode episode. Return the complete newest stored pair and stop when workflow_state is complete.
Use ordinary exact recall whenever the user supplies a non-Clipboard Recall Key or Record ID. Do not add semantic or Collection-number selectors to an exact request.

When no exact identifier is known and the user is describing an ordinary Episodic Memory, use memory_type episodic with query_description and infer concrete ISO date_from/date_to values only when relevant. If workflow_state is selection_required, choose the best candidate Record ID and make exactly one second exact call with the same result_mode. Stop when workflow_state is complete.

For Collection numbered retrieval, set memory_type collection, supply exactly one exact Collection ID or exact Collection Name, and translate the user's request into selection_mode and its matching fields. Preserve the user's order for an explicit episode_numbers list. A Collection response with workflow_state complete is final; report unavailable/deleted and token-omitted numbers clearly.
Use result_mode episode by default. Never request result_mode description for Clipboard Memory. Use description only when the user explicitly requests only Episodic or Collection descriptions.

field_descriptions.memory_type: Use clipboard for exact M1-M100 newest-slot retrieval, collection for numbered Collection retrieval, or episodic for semantic Episodic retrieval. It may be omitted for ordinary shared exact recall.
field_descriptions.recall_key: An exact stored Recall Key. M1 through M100 deterministically recall only the newest active Clipboard pair in that slot.
field_descriptions.record_id: An exact Episodic or Collection Record ID used for deterministic direct recall or the second call after semantic candidate selection. Clipboard recall does not use Record ID.
field_descriptions.query_description: The semantic description of the sought Episodic Memory. Use only when no exact identifier is known and memory_type is episodic.
field_descriptions.date_from: Optional inclusive UTC lower bound for semantic Episodic recall, expressed as an ISO date or datetime.
field_descriptions.date_to: Optional inclusive UTC upper bound for semantic Episodic recall, expressed as an ISO date or datetime.
field_descriptions.collection_id: The exact stable Collection ID for numbered Collection retrieval. Supply it instead of Collection Name when known.
field_descriptions.collection_name: The exact Collection Name for numbered retrieval when the stable ID is not supplied.
field_descriptions.selection_mode: Collection selector: episode_number, episode_numbers, range, first, last, or all.
field_descriptions.episode_number: One positive permanent episode number; valid only with selection_mode episode_number.
field_descriptions.episode_numbers: An ordered list of positive permanent episode numbers; valid only with selection_mode episode_numbers.
field_descriptions.range_start: Inclusive positive range start; valid only with selection_mode range.
field_descriptions.range_end: Inclusive positive range end; valid only with selection_mode range.
field_descriptions.count: Positive number of available episodes requested by selection_mode first or last.
field_descriptions.result_mode: Select episode for complete stored content. Description mode is available only for Episodic or Collection Memory, never Clipboard.
